verdict: Paid ads paused since Sep 12; all 16 leads came in the first 11 days.
narrative: All 16 leads and all $277.94 in ad spend landed between September 4 and 15 — Meta campaigns have had zero spend for the 20 days since. Organic search interest is actually climbing (search clicks up 62% week over week), but that momentum has no paid support behind it right now. Your Google Business Profile drove 209 actions this period — 85 calls and 95 direction requests — though map visibility softened in the most recent week. Ads are being reactivated, and the lead-tracking discrepancy between your ad platform and your CRM is being reconciled so the next period's numbers are clean. Expect a return to consistent daily lead flow once campaigns are back live.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all arriving in the first 11 days before ads paused
cost per lead while ads were running — a healthy rate worth restoring
Google Business Profile actions this period — calls, direction requests, and site visits — with no paid support

watch_item.issue: Meta campaigns have had zero spend for 20 consecutive days, halting all paid lead flow.
watch_item.fix: Campaigns are being reactivated this week; spend and lead delivery will resume immediately upon going live.
